stats.name: blockedShots
stats.description: The number shots blocked by a defender.

stats.name: effectiveClearance
stats.description: The number of clearances that stops the attack of the opposing team.

stats.name: effectiveTackles
stats.description: The number of tackles where the player wins the ball.

stats.name: inneffectiveTackles
stats.description: The number of tackles where the player doesn't win the ball.

stats.name: interceptions
stats.description: The number of interceptions.

stats.name: tacklePct
stats.description: The perencentage of tackles where the player wins the ball.

stats.name: totalClearance
stats.description: The number of clearances attempted.

stats.name: totalTackles
stats.description: The number of tackles attempted.

stats.name: possWonAtt3rd
stats.description: Total number of times possession was regained in the attacking third of the field

stats.name: possWonDef3rd
stats.description: Total number of times possession was regained in the defensive third of the field

stats.name: possWonMid3rd
stats.description: Total number of times possession was regained in the midfield third of the field

stats.name: ballRecovery
stats.description: When a player takes possession of a loose ball, or switch of possession between teams when the ball is in open play

stats.name: attemptsConcededIbox
stats.description: An attempt conceded from a shot from inside the box

stats.name: attemptsConcededObox
stats.description: An attempt conceded from a shot from outside the box

stats.name: goalsConcededIbox
stats.description: Goal conceded from a shot inside the box

stats.name: goalsConcededObox
stats.description: Goal conceded from a shot outside the box

stats.name: ppda
stats.description: Measures how many opposition passes a team allows before making a defensive action, indicating pressing intensity—lower values mean stronger pressing. Note: Calculation formula = opposition_passes / defensive_actions

stats.name: fkFoulLost
stats.description: All fouls by individual players, essentially counting all free kicks lost. It could be described as fouls conceded, fouls committed or free kicks conceded, they are practically equivalent (include penalties, and handballs)

stats.name: challengeLost
stats.description: Challenge that did not make contact, i.e. a missed challenge where the player was dribbled past (therefore, there cannot be a 'challengeWon' metric)

stats.name: defensiveActions
stats.description: Number of defensive moves made by the team in the defensive third

stats.name: offsideProvoked
stats.description: Awarded to the last defender when an offside decision is given

stats.name: appearances
stats.description: The number of times a player has made an appearance in a match.

stats.name: avgRatingFromCorrespondent
stats.description: The rating from a correspondent for a player.

stats.name: avgRatingFromDataFeed
stats.description: The rating from the data feed for a player.

stats.name: avgRatingFromEditor
stats.description: The rating from the editor(s) for a player.

stats.name: avgRatingFromUser
stats.description: The average user rating for a player.

stats.name: dnp
stats.description: The number of times a player did not play in a match.

stats.name: draws
stats.description: The number of times the scored ended even for both teams in a match and there was no extra time.

stats.name: foulsCommitted
stats.description: The number of fouls comitted by a player or team.

stats.name: foulsSuffered
stats.description: The number of fouls suffered by a player or team.

stats.name: goalDifference
stats.description: The difference of goals scored and goals conceded.

stats.name: handBalls
stats.description: The number of handball fouls committed..

stats.name: losses
stats.description: The number of times a team has lost a match.

stats.name: lostCorners
stats.description: The number of corners conceded to the opposing team.

stats.name: minutes
stats.description: The number of minutes played by a player.

stats.name: ownGoals
stats.description: The number of own goals conceded.

stats.name: passPct
stats.description: The percentage of passes that result in the ball finding its target.

stats.name: redCards
stats.description: The number of red cards that have been issued.

stats.name: starts
stats.description: The number of starts a player has made in matches.

stats.name: subIns
stats.description: The number of times a player has come on a sub in a match.

stats.name: subOuts
stats.description: The number of times a player has been subbed off in a match.

stats.name: suspensions
stats.description: The number of matches a player has been suspended.

stats.name: timeEnded
stats.description: The time a match ends.

stats.name: timeStarted

stats.name: attemptsIbox
stats.description: An attempted shot from inside the box

stats.name: attemptsObox
stats.description: An attempted shot from outside the box

stats.name: postScoringAtt
stats.description: Shot that hits the post or bar

stats.name: dispossessed
stats.description: A player in possession gets tackled by an opposition player when they are not attempting to dribble past (attempted take on) an opposition player.

stats.name: unsuccessfulTouch
stats.description: A player only touched the ball and lost possession – bad control

stats.name: attPenTarget
stats.description: A penalty that was saved by the goalkeeper

stats.name: fouledFinalThird
stats.description: A foul that occurs in the final third of the pitch (in relation to the attacking player's final third, ie attacking third)

stats.name: firstHalfGoals
stats.description: The total number of goals scored in the first half of the match (total, both teams combined)

stats.name: hitWoodwork
stats.description: Total number of occasions the ball hit the woodwork in any situation (includes blocked onto or saved but not goals)

stats.name: totalFastbreak
stats.description: Total number of fast breaks that occurred

stats.name: accurateThrows
stats.description: All accurate throw-ins

stats.name: totalThrows
stats.description: Total number of throw-ins

stats.name: totalBackZonePass
stats.description: Total number of passes that end in the player's own half – excluding throw-ins and keeper throws

stats.name: totalFwdZonePass
stats.description: Total number of passes that end in the opposition half (includes crosses).
